docs.title: ABOUT ME
docs.text:
TL;DR

I analyze fintech products, SaaS platforms, AI tools, and marketing campaigns. I love digging into data, decoding user behavior, and turning insights into smarter decisions. Also big on football tactics, coffee-fueled curiosity, and clean dashboards.

  • Experience That Scales

    Worked as a business analyst across fintech products, SaaS platforms, AI tools, and digital marketing. Drove product growth, led performance analysis, managed cross-functional teams, and improved operational workflows. Focused on aligning user needs with business strategy to deliver measurable impact.

    ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎

    Go to My Experience

  • Learning That Sticks

    Master of Management in Business Data Analytics from the University of Windsor; Dean’s Honour Award recipient. Magna Cum Laude BBA in Marketing from East West University. Combined business insight with data skills to solve complex challenges.

    Go to Education

  • Products That Work

    Led the end-to-end deployment of a voice-command feature & Local Storage Feature for a SaaS content platform. Conducted research, wrote BRDs, collaborated with devs and QA, and helped roll out a high-impact product that boosted engagement and adoption.

    Go to Projects

  • Impact Beyond the Classroom

    Top 6 in Unilever BizMaestros and Top 3 in HSBC Business Case Competition. Represented university in national contests. Served as student representative and Vice President of the University Business Club.

    Go to Achievements
